answer: In PoA, each identity is admitted only after a VDF transcript proves a prescribed chain of continuous sequential modular squarings, with every square dependent on the preceding result. An attacker may provision GPUs, but they cannot shorten one chain or make multiple clones mature before the same wall-clock delay; each clone requires its own physical bottleneck. Thus identities branded comet, umber, or glacier incur real time and energy, making Sybil expansion uneconomic.
